text.text: Gakken Compact Vision TV Boy was a Japanese home video game console released in 1983. Designed as a competitor to the Epoch Cassette Vision, it used a unique cartridge-based design where much of the game hardware was contained within each cartridge. The system featured simple arcade-style games including ports of titles such as Frogger and Super Cobra. With only six officially released games and limited availability, the TV Boy became a rare second-generation console remembered for its unusual design.
